content.summary: Financial analyst with 9 years of experience in reporting, budgeting, control testing, and decision support for multi-entity commercial operations.

bullets: Prepared monthly performance packs for six entities representing TZS 84 billion in annual revenue.
Automated variance analysis in Power BI, reducing board-report preparation time by 36%.
Tested financial controls across 42 processes and closed 93% of remediation actions within target dates.

experience.title: Audit Associate
bullets: Performed audit testing for 30 commercial clients, identifying 57 actionable control improvements.
Prepared IFRS working papers that passed manager review with 98% first-pass accuracy.
